name: leadops-ai
description: Human-in-the-loop lead operations platform for AI-assisted agencies.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
